desc: The Draco Tactical Pistol is chambered in 7.62x39mm, features a 7.5” barrel, with a Linear Compensator. This compact package comes with Strike Industries Bi-Folding Pistol Brace. All New US Palm Free Float M-LOK Handguard. It also features an Picatinny Rail Integrated Rear Sight. Along with an Enhanced Safety Bolt Hold Open, the Legendary RAK- 1Trigger.
